searchText: It is almost *always* the max fee that makes transactions take a long time. Priority fee comes into play very rarely based on the last data I have seen. literally never bad any issue with setting the priority fee to 1 I actually deliberately go out of my way to change what Metamask recommends and put in 1 instead of 2-3 because I refuse to overpay always gets confirmed shortly (as long as max fee is large enough)
